purpose: Skeleton of a political system that protects the economic system from capture while protecting individual liberty from government itself — by integrating constitutional structure, democracy, federalism, administration, public finance, justice, anti-corruption, data/AI rights, and public measurement.

power_loop.name: Legitimate Power Loop
power_loop.purpose: Strengthen this loop so government remains answerable to people and prosperity outcomes.
power_loop.one_sentence: People authorize constrained government through constitution and democratic channels; administration deploys public resources; measured outcomes feed accountability back to people.

capture_loop.name: Extractive Capture Loop
capture_loop.purpose: Break this loop structurally — home mechanisms live on LOCK-05/06/09 and related bones; Stage 2/4 prove them.
capture_loop.one_sentence: Concentrated wealth purchases political influence that rewrites contracts, regulation, and public-asset rules to enlarge itself — Constitutional Capitalism must interrupt each arrow.

master_architecture_fragment.title: Government & Democratic Power Engine
master_architecture_fragment.one_sentence: Constitutional Capitalism uses constrained democratic government to protect broad ownership and household prosperity from capture, while hard rights and measurement keep the state from becoming the new extractive center.

flow.label: Constitution and rights set what government may and may never do (GP-01)
Elections and direct democracy authorize and constrain governing power (GP-02, GP-03)
Federalism assigns functions; administrative state executes under accountability (GP-04, GP-05)
Public finance, procurement, and justice deploy community capital without extraction (GP-06, GP-07)
Anti-corruption, data/AI rights, and public measurement close the Power Loop and attack the Capture Loop (GP-08, GP-09, GP-10)

structural_areas.problem: Without hard limits, political majorities or agencies can erase liberty; without affirmative structure, government cannot protect households from private capture either.
structural_areas.objective: Define what government may do, what it may never do, and which rights remain beyond ordinary political majorities.
structural_areas.mechanism: Constitutional defense framework; foundational axioms; equal standing; citizenship as mutual obligation — not as a license for state domination.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: The constitution is public supreme law; rights are not state property. Funding of rights enforcement is a core public duty.
structural_areas.household_effect: Security of person, conscience, speech, due process, and equal standing while participating in prosperity architecture.

os_check.ownership: People retain rights; government holds limited delegated authority
os_check.capital_formation: Stable rights enable long-horizon household and firm investment
os_check.household_economics: Liberty and security are preconditions of usable surplus
os_check.power: Hard rights block both majority tyranny and state capture of persons

unresolved_deferred.item: Federal supremacy conflicts on specific rights floors

structural_areas.problem: Representation can drift from citizen preference through districting, access barriers, low information, and donor-skewed campaigns.
structural_areas.objective: Make political representation accurately translate citizen preference into governing authority.
structural_areas.mechanism: Democracy framework: election integrity, access, competitive representation design, civic capacity — harvest existing material; age-16 local suffrage remains hypothesis only.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Elections are public infrastructure; campaign resources must not become ownership of offices (joins GP-08).
structural_areas.household_effect: Votes map to policy that affects wages, services, taxes, and place.

os_check.ownership: Offices are public trusts, not private assets
os_check.capital_formation: Predictable democratic turnover without oligarchic lock-in
os_check.market_design: Election rules as political market design against monopoly of office
os_check.power: Core authorization channel in the Power Loop

unresolved_deferred.item: Specific districting / primary reform package for Arkansas

structural_areas.problem: If all power sits in elected institutions, capture of those institutions captures the people; if direct tools are unbound, majorities can strip rights.
structural_areas.objective: Reserve specific powers directly with the people while keeping rights and hard cores protected.
structural_areas.mechanism: People's Branch / popular sovereignty framework; citizen service; collaborative constitutional review (deferred build) as participation channel — not endless ballot chaos.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Direct democratic instruments are public process infrastructure; cost and signature rules must not become pay-to-play.
structural_areas.household_effect: Citizens can correct drift without waiting for elite permission.

os_check.ownership: Ultimate political ownership remains with the people
os_check.capital_formation: Stable rules for initiatives/referenda reduce speculative politics
os_check.household_economics: Households can defend local prosperity rules

structural_areas.problem: Wrong-level assignment creates either remote capture or local incapacity; preemption and grants can hollow home rule.
structural_areas.objective: Assign functions by subsidiarity and capacity — clear federalism, home rule, and shared-service rules.
structural_areas.mechanism: Federalism framework; community operating system for local build; regional shared services where county capacity fails.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Each level owns distinct fiscal and operational duties; LOCK-06 joins municipal finance to engines.
structural_areas.household_effect: Services delivered at the nearest competent level without runaway remote bureaucracy.

os_check.ownership: Who owns which public function and revenue stream
os_check.capital_formation: Local public capital vs state/federal capital roles
os_check.market_design: Procurement and regulation layered without double capture
os_check.power: Prevent one level from becoming the capture chokepoint

structural_areas.problem: Agencies, boards, and commissions can drift into capture, opacity, or mission creep while remaining essential to delivery.
structural_areas.objective: Make agencies, boards, commissions, and civil service operate with competence and continuous accountability.
structural_areas.mechanism: Government capacity / public service framework; performance and sunset review (LOCK-09); transparent rulemaking; civil service as capability not patronage.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Agencies steward public capital; they do not own policy; budgets join GP-06.
structural_areas.household_effect: Reliable permits, benefits, safety, and services without arbitrary power.

os_check.capital_formation: State capacity as productive institutional capital
os_check.market_design: Regulatory design that does not sell outcomes
os_check.household_economics: Time cost of bureaucracy and service quality
os_check.power: Administrative discretion is a primary capture surface

structural_areas.problem: Budgets and contracts can leak to favoritism and out-of-state extraction; property-tax dependence and opaque procurement recreate capture.
structural_areas.objective: Budget, purchase, contract, and deploy public capital without extraction or favoritism — post-property-tax viable local finance.
structural_areas.mechanism: LOCK-06 bone: Community Prosperity Ledger replacements; open contracting; Arkansas-competitive procurement within legal bounds; AEDC incentive→equity path (parallel legal).
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Public money is community capital; vendors do not own the state; baseline corpus is reference infrastructure.
structural_areas.household_effect: Better services per dollar; less tax burden on ordinary homes as engines mature.

os_check.ownership: Who owns vendors, incentives, and public equity stakes
os_check.capital_formation: Procurement as local capital formation tool
os_check.household_economics: Incidence of taxes and quality of funded services
os_check.power: Contracts are a Capture Loop arrow — must be broken here

structural_areas.problem: Courts, corrections, policing, fire, EMS, and re-entry can either protect household security or become extractive, racialized, or fiscally self-perpetuating systems.
structural_areas.objective: Fit justice and public safety inside the prosperity framework — safety, restoration, and reduced future liability.
structural_areas.mechanism: Justice framework; equal standing; constitutional defense; re-entry as human-capital and household restoration; community safety joins Pass 2 resilience.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Public safety is a core public duty; private prison / extractive fee models are capture risks (LOCK-05/09).
structural_areas.household_effect: Personal security without asset-destroying justice traps.

os_check.ownership: Who owns facilities and supervision systems
os_check.capital_formation: Re-entry as human-capital recovery vs permanent exclusion
os_check.household_economics: Crime, incarceration, and family surplus destruction
os_check.power: Coercive power must stay inside rights and accountability

structural_areas.problem: Lobbying, campaign finance, contracting, patronage, and concentrated wealth can purchase government and reverse prosperity rules.
structural_areas.objective: Prevent economic concentration from reconcentrating political power — break the Capture Loop.
structural_areas.mechanism: LOCK-09: open contracting; lobbying/campaign-finance constraints hostile to pay-to-play within free-speech doctrine; revolving-door limits; beneficial-ownership transparency; forensic audit governance; OpenFEC/OpenStates infrastructure already built.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Politics must be fundable without donor ownership of policy; public disclosure is default.
structural_areas.household_effect: Rules stay aligned with broad prosperity rather than donor portfolios.

os_check.ownership: Beneficial owners of influence and contractors
os_check.capital_formation: Stop converting public rules into private capital rents
os_check.market_design: Political markets must not auction policy
os_check.household_economics: Capture raises prices and taxes on households

How to fund politics without donor capture or state speech monopoly

structural_areas.problem: Public data and AI can enlarge prosperity or enable surveillance, discrimination, and concentrated digital power.
structural_areas.objective: Define who owns/controls public data, what privacy rights exist, and what limits constrain surveillance and automated government.
structural_areas.mechanism: LOCK-08: data minimization; citizen data rights; AI procurement/audit for agencies; anti-surveillance firewalls; HYP-134 remains parallel evidence-only until series bound — not COUNTABLE revenue.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Public data is a public asset with citizen rights; models trained on public contribution create proportional public claim (joins Pass 1) without government owning all AI.
structural_areas.household_effect: Service convenience without a control state; protection from automated injustice.

unresolved_deferred.item: Arkansas privacy statutory floor above federal minima
Public AI inventory and audit protocol

structural_areas.problem: Without continuous public measurement, government can claim success while household prosperity stagnates — and capture hides inside narrative.
structural_areas.objective: Enable citizens to continuously determine whether government is increasing shared prosperity.
structural_areas.mechanism: Transparency / People's Ledger; national baseline metrics; Human Flourishing Index; Build Progress and completion bars; Geographic Money Statements and Household Prosperity Surplus queued to Pass 4.
structural_areas.ownership_funding: Measurement systems are public goods; data must be open enough for citizen audit without violating GP-09 rights.
structural_areas.household_effect: Visible link from policy → household outcomes; trustworthy feedback into the Power Loop.

os_check.ownership: Who controls official statistics and dashboards
os_check.capital_formation: Measurement as institutional capital for learning
os_check.market_design: Publish outcomes that reveal extractive markets
os_check.household_economics: Household Prosperity Surplus is the north star metric (Pass 4 detail)
os_check.power: Measurement without capture of the measuring stick
